consequence.text: If you apply after your return semester, the system shows you are not eligible.

steps: In mySNU, go to 학사정보 > 수업/성적 > 성적 > 학점인정신청 and click 신청 under [군휴학 원격수업].
Click 기취득성적에서불러오기 and select the courses you want credited.

summary: If you took remote courses during military service, apply in mySNU for credit; 7 Sep–11 Dec 2026 is recommended.
title: Apply for military remote-course credit recognition

translations.2026학년도 2학기 군 복학자 중 군복무 기간에 수강하였던 군 원격수업: Among students returning from military service in the 2nd semester of 2026, those who wish to have the military remote courses they took during their service recognized for credit should refer to the application period and method below.
translations.복학 학기 지난 후 신청하시는 경우 신청 대상자가 아니라는 안내가 뜨니: Please note that if you apply after the semester of your return, a message will appear saying you are not an eligible applicant.

original.text: 2026학년도 2학기 군 복학자 중 군복무 기간에 수강하였던 군 원격수업의 학점인정을 희망하는 학생은 아래의 신청 기간 및 방법을 참고하시기 바랍니다.
- 개강일로부터 일주일 후부터 종강일 전주까지 신청 (2026. 9. 7.(월) ~ 2026. 12. 11.(금) 신청 권장)
1. 신청경로: mySNU > 학사정보 > 수업/성적 > 성적 > 학점인정신청 - [군휴학 원격수업]에서 "신청" 클릭
② 조회되는 과목 중 학점인정 희망 과목 선택
③ 첨부파일에 아래 3번에 해당하는 자료를 증빙자료로 제출
* 2026학년도 1학기 성적부터는 장병e음 사이트에서 성적표 정상 출력 가능하니 해당 자료를 이용
4. 서식 작성방법: '기취득성적에서 불러오기' 조회 → 학점인정을 희망하는 강좌 및 성적 관련 정보 확인 → [붙임] 서식에 동일하게 기재하여 업로드
* 복학 학기 지난 후 신청하시는 경우 신청 대상자가 아니라는 안내가 뜨니 참고하시기 바랍니다. (서식)의 회색 글씨로 된 예시는 삭제 후 작성

english: Students returning from military service in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year who wish to receive credit recognition (having credits officially counted toward the degree) for military online courses taken during their military service should refer to the application period and method below.
<Application Period>
- Apply from one week after the first day of classes until the week before the last day of classes (recommended application period: 7 Sep 2026 (Mon) ~ 11 Dec 2026 (Fri))
<How to Apply>

1. Application path: mySNU > 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 성적 (Grades) > 학점인정신청 (Credit Recognition Application) - click "신청" (Apply) in [군휴학 원격수업] (Online Courses during Military Leave of Absence)
2. Application method:
① On the [군휴학 원격수업] (Online Courses during Military Leave of Absence) screen, click "기취득성적에서불러오기" (Load from Previously Earned Grades)
② From the courses displayed, select the courses for which you want credit recognition
③ Attach the documents listed in item 3 below as supporting documents (proof)
④ Save temporarily (임시저장) and submit the application (신청)
3. Supporting documents to upload as attachments
Category
Documents to Submit
If you already have a previously issued document
Grade report from 나라사랑포털 (Nara Sarang Portal) / 장병e음 (Jangbyeong e-Eum, online learning site for military personnel)
If you do not have a previously issued document
Fill in the 'form' attached to this notice and upload it
* From the 1st semester 2026 grades onward, grade reports can be printed normally from the 장병e음 (Jangbyeong e-Eum) website, so please use that document.

4. How to fill in the form: Check '기취득성적에서 불러오기' (Load from Previously Earned Grades) → Confirm the course and grade information for the courses you want credit recognition for → Enter the same information in the [Attachment] form and upload it

* Please note that if you apply after your semester of return has ended, a message will appear stating that you are not eligible to apply. In the (form), delete the examples written in grey text before filling it in.
